subject: Problem adding geoJson layer in Leaflet in Shiny tabPanel

messages.author: d36d5dc7abd40a18
messages.subject: Problem adding geoJson layer in Leaflet in Shiny tabPanel
parts:
Hello,

I've been struggling to display a geoJson layer on leaflet when it is inside a tabpanel in Shiny. It seems to be a problem on the way the position attribute on the css file works. I have managed to display the map that didn't appear at the beginning by creating my own css file adding the following instruction: .leaflet-container { position: absolute; }, although the layers still do not appear. I have try different configurations on the css files without any result.

 This is my code: 

## app.css

h1              { color: #000; }


/* Customize fonts */
body, label, input, button, select { 
  font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica;
  font-weight: 200;
}
h1, h2, h3, h4 { font-weight: 400; }


.leaflet-container {
  position: absolute;
}


## ui.R

library(shiny)
library(leaflet)

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel('Customer Satisfaction PoC',
              tags$head( 
                tags$link(rel="stylesheet", type="text/css", href="app.css")
                )
              ),
  sidebarPanel(
    conditionalPanel( condition = "input.tabs == 'Maps'",

    h4("Type of Map"),
    
    selectInput("selectSegmentacion", "",
                c("Map 1" = "map_1",
                  "Map 2" = "map_2"),
                 multiple = FALSE)),
    conditionalPanel( condition = "input.tabs == 'Tab 2'",
    
    br(),
    h4('Advance Segmentation')
    )
  ),
  mainPanel(
    tabsetPanel(id="tabs",
      tabPanel("Tab 2", 
        h3('Dashboard')               
      ),
      tabPanel("Maps",
leafletMap("map", width="100%", height="100%",
 initialTileLayer = "//{s}.tiles.mapbox.com/v3/jcheng.map-5ebohr46/{z}/{x}/{y}.png",
 options=list(
   center = c(40.423715, -3.690523),
   zoom = 6
 )
)   
      )
    )
  )
))


## server.R

library(shiny)
library(leaflet)


shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  
 
  map <- createLeafletMap(session, "map")
  load("www/CCAA.R")
  

  session$onFlushed(once=TRUE, function() {
  
      for (i in 1:length(temp_ccaa[[3]])){

          map$addGeoJSON(temp_ccaa[[3]][[i]], layerId = paste("",i,sep=""))
      }
      
  })
  
})

Can someone give me a clue of what can I do to make it works.

Thanks in advance

messages.author: 68ce5dd269fd758c
messages.subject: Re: Problem adding geoJson layer in Leaflet in Shiny tabPanel
parts:
I never met such problem, but maybe you can start from: 
1. include style in tag: 
tags$head( 
                tags$style(' .leaflet-container { position: absolute; }')
                )
If it doesn't work, check the 'Z-index' of Leaflet map by 'inspect  element'.
